newsitem.title: USA: Castle Energy sees substantial sale gain.
newsitem.headline: Castle Energy sees substantial sale gain.

text.p: Castle Energy Corp has agreed to sell its Rusk County, Texas, oil and natural gas properties and pipeline for about $54 million and will have "a substantial gain" on the sale, chief executive Joseph Castel II said Monday.
He said the sale to Union Pacific Resources Group Inc will result in a pretax gain of roughly $20 million.
Closing is expected before the end of the month but is subject to customary conditions, the company said.
Castle said the company will retain two operating segments after the sale -- the gas marketing operations relating to the Lone Star Contract and its non-Texas exploration and production operations.

He said Castle Energy expects to use a portion of the sale proceeds to retire bank debt and that the board is considering alternatives for the use of the proceeds remaining from the sale and the cash to be generated from the Lone Star Contract which terminates at May 31, 1999.
This would be in addition to the stock buy back announced in March, he said.
Castle Energy owns a gas sales contract with ENSERCH Corp's Lone Star Gas Co, a 77-mile intrastate pipeline in Rusk County, calling for delivery of 45 million cubic feet of gas daily, Castle said.
The company said it also owns interests in over 425 wells and is the operator of about 350 wells throughout the United States. ((-- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.))
